literal: Shengzong, Part Four
idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Four

literal: In the eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on xinsi day, went to Taihu.
idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tonghe, on xinsi day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Taihu.

literal: On gengyin day an edict ordered deciding delayed cases.
idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered the clearing of backlogged cases.

literal: On gengzi day went to Shenzi Marsh.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the Emperor went to Shenzi Marsh.

literal: In the second month, on the dingwei new moon, Khotan and the Uyghur each dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the second month Khotan and the Uyghur each sent tribute envoys.

literal: On renshen day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On renshen day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the third month, on dingchou day, Li Jiqian dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingchou day in the third month Li Jiqian of Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengchen day Venus and Mars battled, altogether fifteen times.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Venus and Mars came into conjunction fifteen times.

literal: On yiyou day walled Xingguo and filled it with Song captives.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the court fortified Xingguo and settled it with Song captives.

literal: On xinchou day Yi Prefecture was established.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Yi Prefecture was established.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on the bingwu new moon, Yan Prefecture prefect Li Shouying had benevolent administration; the people requested he remain; it was granted.
idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the fourth summer month Yan Prefecture prefect Li Shouying had governed well; when the people asked that he stay, the request was granted.

literal: On gengxu day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengwu day because of year drought, the various departments had difficult food; relief was given.
idiomatic: On gengwu day, because drought had left the tribes short of food, relief was distributed.

literal: In the fifth month, on wuzi day, Song surrendered soldiers were distributed and assigned to the various armies.
idiomatic: On wuzi day of the fifth month surrendered Song soldiers were distributed among the various armies.

literal: On gengyin day Jurchen chancellor Ahai came with tribute and was enfeoffed Prince of Shunhua.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Jurchen chancellor Ahai came with tribute and was enfeoffed Prince of Shunhua.

literal: On bingshen day summered for coolness at Hutu White Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the court took the summer retreat at Hutu White Mountain.

literal: An edict ordered surveying private fields.
idiomatic: An edict ordered a survey of private farmland.

literal: In the sixth month, on bingwu day, Northern Privy Chancellor Morugu was made Northern Chancellery Great King.
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the sixth month Northern Privy Chancellor Morugu was appointed Northern Chancellery Great King.

literal: Arsalan Uyghur yuyue and dalagan each dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: The Arsalan Uyghur yuyue and dalagan each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiayin day the moon occulted the first star of Tiansi.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon passed before the first star of the Celestial Team.

literal: On bingchen day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengchen day, Nanjing Bear Army was changed to Divine Army.
idiomatic: On gengchen day in the seventh autumn month Nanjing's Bear Army was renamed the Divine Army.

literal: An edict ordered the Eastern Capital Circuit palace divisions to set up sub-jurisdictions, established Dingba, Baohe, and Xuanhua three counties, and established one county each at Hongli in Baichuan Prefecture, Guangyi in Yikun Prefecture, Changqing in Liaoxi Prefecture, and Ande in Qian Prefecture.
idiomatic: An edict ordered sub-jurisdictions for the Eastern Capital Circuit palace divisions, created Dingba, Baohe, and Xuanhua counties, and added one county each to Baichuan, Yikun, Liaoxi, and Qian prefectures.

literal: Suai, Gui, Song, Rao, Ning, Hai, Rui, Yu, Tieli, Fengde, and ten other prefectures were abolished, and Yutian, Liaofeng, Songshan, Hongyuan, Huaiqing, Yunlong, Pingze, Pingshan, and eight other counties were abolished; their people were distributed and assigned to other commanderies.
idiomatic: Ten prefectures including Suai, Gui, Song, Rao, Ning, Hai, Rui, Yu, Tieli, and Fengde were abolished, along with eight counties including Yutian, Liaofeng, Songshan, Hongyuan, Huaiqing, Yunlong, Pingze, and Pingshan; their populations were reassigned to other jurisdictions.

literal: In the eighth month, on yimao day, black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the eighth month the court sacrificed black and white sheep to heaven and earth.

literal: In the ninth month, on yihai day, the four divisions of the Northern Jurchen requested internal attachment.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the ninth month the four divisions of the Northern Jurchen asked to submit.

literal: On renchen day Li Jiqian presented Song captives.
idiomatic: On renchen day Li Jiqian presented Song captives.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on bingwu day, because of greatly defeating the Song army, envoys were again dispatched to come and report.
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the tenth winter month, after a great victory over Song forces, envoys were again sent to report the news.

literal: On jiyou day the Zubu and others dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the Zubu and others sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That month the imperial presence halted at Dawang River.
idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Dawang River.

literal: In the eleventh month, on gengyin day, because the Tuyuhun people were hungry, relief was given.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the eleventh month, because the Tuyuhun were starving, relief was distributed.

literal: On dingyou day the Great White Star appeared in daytime.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Venus was visible in daylight.

literal: In the twelfth month, on guimao day, Li Jiqian took Song Lin, Fu, and other prefectures and dispatched envoys to come and report.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the twelfth month Li Jiqian captured Song's Lin, Fu, and other prefectures and sent envoys to report.

literal: The Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: The Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengxu day envoys were dispatched to enfeoff Li Jiqian as King of Xia.
idiomatic: On gengxu day envoys were sent to invest Li Jiqian as King of Xia.

literal: On guichou day the Uyghur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On guichou day the Uyghur came with tribute.

literal: That year Zheng Yuncong and two others were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year Zheng Yuncong and two others passed the examinations.

literal: In the ninth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on jiaxu day, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tonghe, on jiaxu day of the first spring month, the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On bingzi day an edict forbade privately ordaining monks and nuns.
idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict forbade private ordination of monks and nuns.

literal: On gengchen day went to Taihu.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor went to Taihu.

literal: On yiyou day Commissioner of Military Affairs and overseer of the state history Shi Fang and others presented the Veritable Records; gifts were granted in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Commissioner of Military Affairs and state-history overseer Shi Fang and others presented the Veritable Records, and rewards were granted according to rank.

literal: On wuzi day five hundred Song surrendered soldiers were selected and established as the Xuanli Army.
idiomatic: On wuzi day five hundred surrendered Song soldiers were organized as the Xuanli Army.

literal: On xinmao day an edict exempted rent and taxes of the three capitals and various circuits, and still abolished the field survey.
idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict exempted rent and taxes throughout the three capitals and all circuits and abolished the field survey.

literal: In the second month, on bingwu day, Xia State dispatched envoys to report victory attacking Song.
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the second month Western Xia sent envoys reporting victory over Song.

literal: On dingwei day Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Wangliu was made tiyin.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Wangliu was appointed tiyin.

literal: On jiazi day Weikou, Zhenhua, and Laiyuan three cities were built and garrison troops stationed.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the cities of Weikou, Zhenhua, and Laiyuan were built and garrison troops stationed there.

literal: In the intercalary month, on the xinwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon of the intercalary month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On renshen day Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu, Three Departments commissioner Li Si, supervisory censor Liu Jing, administrative secretary Zhang Gan, and Nanjing vice regent Wu Hao were dispatched to separately decide delayed cases of the various circuits.
idiomatic: On renshen day Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu, Three Departments commissioner Li Si, supervisory censor Liu Jing, administrative secretary Zhang Gan, and Nanjing vice regent Wu Hao were sent to clear backlogged cases across the circuits.

literal: In the third month, on the gengzi new moon, the Shiwei and Wugu tribes were relieved.
idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the third month relief was given to the Shiwei and Wugu tribes.

literal: On wushen day Treasury Department outer section member Ma Shouqi, Granary Department outer section member Qi Zheng, Works Department outer section member Cui You, and Jibei county magistrate Cui Jian and others were again dispatched to separately decide delayed cases of the various circuits.
idiomatic: On wushen day Ma Shouqi, Qi Zheng, Cui You, Cui Jian, and others were again sent to clear backlogged cases across the circuits.

literal: On jiazi day the court favorably visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the court visited Nanjing.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on jiaxu day, the Uyghur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the fourth summer month the Uyghur came with tribute.

literal: On yihai day King of Xia Li Jiqian dispatched Du Bai to come and thank the enfeoffment patent.
idiomatic: On yihai day King of Xia Li Jiqian sent Du Bai to court to thank the court for his investiture.

literal: On bingxu day summered for coolness at Coal Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

literal: In the fifth month, on jiwei day, Qin King Han Kuangsi's private walled city was made Quan Prefecture.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the fifth month Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi's private fortified town was made Quan Prefecture.

literal: In the sixth month, on dinghai day, the Turks came with tribute.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the sixth month the Turks came with tribute.

literal: That month continuous rain at Nanjing damaged the crops.
idiomatic: That month prolonged rain at Nanjing damaged the crops.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on guimao day, household registers were universally surveyed.
idiomatic: On guimao day in the seventh autumn month a universal household registration was ordered.

literal: On yisi day an edict ordered the various circuits to recommend talent and conduct, investigate greed and cruelty, care for the elderly, forbid extravagance and usurpation, and give office to the sons and grandsons of those who died in royal service.
idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered the circuits to recommend able men, investigate corruption and cruelty, care for the elderly, forbid extravagance and overstepping rank, and appoint the descendants of those who died in state service.

literal: On jiwei day Xia State, because of recovering Sui and Yin two prefectures, dispatched envoys to come and report.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Western Xia, having recovered Sui and Yin prefectures, sent envoys to report.

literal: In the eighth month, on guiyou day, Tong Prefecture produced auspicious grain, and sweet dew fell at the Eastern Capital.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the eighth month Tong Prefecture produced stalks of auspicious grain and sweet dew fell at the Eastern Capital.

literal: On wuyin day the Jurchen presented deer-callers.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Jurchen presented deer-callers.

literal: On renwu day the Eastern Capital presented a three-legged crow.
idiomatic: On renwu day the Eastern Capital presented a three-legged crow.

literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, the Bigud came with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the ninth month the Bigud came with tribute.

literal: On jiyou day the imperial presence halted at Miaocheng.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the court encamped at Miaocheng.

literal: Nanjing had an earthquake.
idiomatic: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on dingmao day, Arsalan Uyghur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month Arsalan Uyghur came with tribute.

literal: On renshen day King of Xia Li Jiqian dispatched envoys to come and present Song-granted edict commands.
idiomatic: On renshen day King of Xia Li Jiqian sent envoys presenting edict commands granted by Song.

literal: On dingchou day Dingnan Army military commissioner Li Jipeng came to attach; he was granted the titles Loyal and Obedient, Effectively Filial, Initiating Sage, and Pacifier of Dingnan, Kaifu Yitong Sansi, acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Secretary, and enfeoffed Western Peace King.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Dingnan Army military commissioner Li Jipeng submitted; he was granted the titles Loyal and Obedient, Effectively Filial, Initiating Sage, and Pacifier of Dingnan, made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and acting grand preceptor with concurrent palace secretary, and enfeoffed as Western Peace King.

literal: In the eleventh month, on jihai day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On jihai day of the eleventh month the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: In the twelfth month, King of Xia Li Jiqian secretly attached to Song; pacification commissioner Han Dewei was dispatched to hold an edict and instruct him.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month King of Xia Li Jiqian secretly renewed ties with Song, and pacification commissioner Han Dewei was sent with an edict to rebuke him.

literal: That year jinshi Shi Yongzhong alone was passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year jinshi Shi Yongzhong alone passed the examinations.

literal: In the tenth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on dingyou day, killing horses in funeral rites was forbidden, as was storing armor, gold and silver, and curios.
idiomatic: In the tenth year of Tonghe, on dingyou day of the first spring month, an edict forbade killing horses at funerals and hoarding armor, gold and silver, and luxury goods.

literal: On bingwu day went to Taihu.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor went to Taihu.

literal: In the second month, on the yichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the second month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: Han Dewei memorialized that Li Jiqian claimed illness and did not come out, reached Ling Prefecture taking captives and plundering, then returned.
idiomatic: Han Dewei reported that Li Jiqian pleaded illness and refused to appear, raided Ling Prefecture for captives and plunder, and then withdrew.

literal: On renshen day the Wu'er came with tribute.
idiomatic: On renshen day the Wu'er came with tribute.

literal: On renwu day Yun Prefecture's rent and taxes were exempted.
idiomatic: On renwu day rent and taxes at Yun Prefecture were remitted.

literal: On gengyin day Xia State, because Han Dewei took captives and plundered, dispatched envoys to report; an edict was granted to comfort them.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Western Xia, protesting Han Dewei's raids, sent envoys to court; a comforting edict was issued in reply.

literal: On xinmao day displaced persons of Yun Prefecture were granted relief.
idiomatic: On xinmao day relief was granted to displaced persons in Yun Prefecture.

literal: In the third month, on jiachen day, the Iron Li came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiachen day of the third month the Iron Li came with tribute.

literal: On bingchen day went to Coal Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingchen day the Emperor went to Coal Mountain.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on yichou day, Taihu was made a district of imperial visits.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the fourth summer month Taihu was designated an imperial visitation district.

literal: On gengyin day the hundred officials were ordered to compete in archery.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court held an archery contest for the ministers.

literal: In the fifth month, on guisi day, displaced persons of Shuo Prefecture were granted relief for three years.
idiomatic: On guisi day of the fifth month displaced persons in Shuo Prefecture were granted three years' relief.

literal: In the seventh month, on xinyou day, the Iron Li came with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinyou day of the seventh month the Iron Li came with tribute.

literal: In the eighth month, on guihai day, the crops were viewed, and envoys were still dispatched to separately inspect the seedling crops.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the eighth month the court inspected the crops and sent envoys to review the fields district by district.

literal: In the ninth month, on guimao day, the court favorably visited Wutai Mountain Jinhe Temple to feed the monks.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the ninth month the court visited Jinhe Temple on Wutai Mountain and feasted the monks.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on renshen day, the King of Xia dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On renshen day of the tenth winter month the King of Xia sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On wuyin day the Iron Li came with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Iron Li came with tribute.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen day, the Uyghur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the eleventh month the Uyghur came with tribute.

literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen day, hunted at Ruzhou East River.
idiomatic: On gengchen day of the twelfth month the court hunted at Ruzhou East River.

literal: Heaven was worshipped.
idiomatic: The court performed heaven worship.

literal: That month Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde and others attacked Goryeo.
idiomatic: That month Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde and others were sent to attack Goryeo.

literal: In the eleventh year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on renyin day, the Uyghur came with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Tonghe, on renyin day of the first spring month, the Uyghur came with tribute.

literal: On bingwu day inner treasury money was disbursed and granted to the armies of the Nanjing military command.
idiomatic: On bingwu day money from the inner treasury was distributed to the armies of the Nanjing military command.

literal: Goryeo King Wang Zhi dispatched Park Yangrou with a memorial requesting pardon; an edict took several hundred li of Jurchen land east of the Yalu River and granted it to them.
idiomatic: Goryeo King Wang Zhi sent Park Yangrou with a memorial begging pardon; an edict ceded several hundred li of Jurchen territory east of the Yalu River to Goryeo.

literal: In the second month, on guihai day, Bazhou commoner's wife Lady Wang, because of demonic delusion of the multitude, was executed.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the second month Lady Wang, a commoner's wife of Bazhou, was executed for sorcery that misled the people.

literal: In summer, fourth month, the court favorably visited Coal Mountain for coolness.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

literal: In the sixth month there was great rain.
idiomatic: In the sixth month heavy rains fell.
